P7c: I think moms should raise their own kids, inside a community where the care is really shared. The village can handle meals, supervision, teaching, protection and play, and it can take on a lot of the fathering. It should never take a child away from the mother in the name of liberating her.
P9b: Experiments where kids don't sleep and live with their parents need special caution. Research on Israeli kibbutzim found that they ended the practice of kids sleeping communally for a mix of reasons: developmental findings, parents' preferences and social change. Kids can do well with good group care and plenty of loving adults around them. That's not the same thing as replacing their secure attachment to their parents.
